summaries.message: I’ll inspect the read-only mechanics and saved evidence, compare three roster structures, and produce one fixed full-stage plan without running a simulation.

The prior loss links three duties: keeping artillery damage online, clearing both roadblock segments for each civilian, and physically stopping the final armor. I’m checking whether a durable shell recipient and earlier ranged damage can support all three.

I’m favoring Cardigan for lower-outer self-sustain and Lancet-2 for the upper healer pocket. That frees DP for an earlier Steward deployment across the full eastern flight path. I’m checking the healing gaps and late armor interception before fixing the timeline.

Cardigan’s slower roadblock clearance leaves the second civilian exposed to later officers, so I’m retaining Melantha. The selected structure withdraws her after eastern clearance and one artillery hit, uses Fang for the lower-outer handoff, then returns Fang downstream to catch any armor that passes a full Friston.
